entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
I need to return my VeloBand. Just need a yes or no on if I can do that.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF-8675309. Look, I don't have a lot of time, so let's get to it.

Of course. Pulling that up now... Okay, I see the VeloBand GPS Tracker was delivered on December 15th. Before we proceed, can I ask what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's just not what I wanted. Honestly, I `expected more`. The interface is `confusing` and generally `hard to use`. I even read the `user manual` and the pulse tracking feature makes no sense.
I see. One moment while I review our return policy for you.

Alright, I've checked the policy. It looks like all our items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery, as long as they're in the original condition. You're well within that timeframe, so yes, we can process that return for you.
Great. Finally. So you're sending a shipping label?

Yes. I've just initiated the return in our system. You'll receive an email with a pre-paid shipping label within the next five minutes. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, your refund will be processed.
Okay, that's all I needed. Thanks.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
